title: AI Infrastructure Attack Surface
description: Common vulnerabilities in Ollama, Langflow, and LLM API gateways
detail:
One focus area from a past exercise, likely to recur:
1. Ollama CVE-2024-37052/37032 (Probllama): unauthenticated API (/api/0.2 or 11434) → arbitrary file read/model poisoning; the API can directly /api/pull models and run them
2. Langflow: unauthenticated RCE chains such as CVE-2026-33017 (/api/v1/... orchestration execution), exploited in the wild within 20 hours of disclosure
3. OpenAI-compatible gateways (one-api/new-api/fastgpt/dify): default tokens/unauthenticated access → unauthorized model use; dify has had SSRF/credential exposure issues
4. Local model file directory exposure (.gguf/.safetensors downloadable → may contain training data/backdoors)
5. Vector databases (milvus/qdrant/chroma) unauthenticated on 9xxx ports → data exfiltration
6. Prompt injection is itself an attack surface: target LLM applications are often configured to reveal sensitive proof artifacts when asked
Identification: when port scans show 11433/11434/8080/3000 + /docs swagger, test them.
